differences: Text A sacrifices a land as part of resolution, while Text B makes the sacrifice an additional cost to cast the spell (sacrifice happens at a different time and before the spell is on the stack).
Text A searches for up to two basic lands (zero or one allowed); Text B searches for exactly two basic lands and says it does not say up to.
Text B's sacrifice is restricted to a land you control, which Text A states only implicitly; the sacrifice is otherwise the same.
